message.tecnocinetico.no_shards: You have no Cinetrite Shards to reload
tooltip.tecnocinetico.kinetic_hammer: Strike the Assembly Press 3 times to craft
tooltip.tecnocinetico.module_install: Installed at the Kinetic Weapon Bench
jei.tecnocinetico.press_auto: or 5 s in the Automatic Press
gui.tecnocinetico.bench.drop_module: Place the module here to install it; take it out to remove it
gui.tecnocinetico.bench.need_weapon: Place a weapon on the bench first
jei.tecnocinetico.bench_info: Modules are fitted at the Kinetic Weapon Bench: put the Kinetic Pistol in its slot and each module in its own slot (sight, magazine, barrel or magwell). Take a module out of its slot to remove it and get it back.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.creative_energy_so: Infinite electrical energy (FE) for adjacent machines
tooltip.tecnocinetico.creative_only: Creative testing only: cannot be crafted or obtained
gui.tecnocinetico.skills.title: Engineer Skills
skill.tecnocinetico.weapon_handling.trai: Train by hitting and killing creatures with weapons
skill.tecnocinetico.engineering.train: Train by crafting at the Assembly Press
skill.tecnocinetico.mining.train: Train by mining with the Kinetic Hammer
skill.tecnocinetico.effect.hammer_save: %s%% of strikes don't wear the hammer
tooltip.tecnocinetico.module_seeker: Automatic trajectory: the bullet seeks the enemy closest to the line of fire
tooltip.tecnocinetico.guided_round: Seeks enemies near your aim. Only works with Swarm Guidance installed
message.tecnocinetico.guided_needs_modul: Magazines with Guided Rounds need Swarm Guidance installed
tooltip.tecnocinetico.magazine_fill: R with the magazine in hand: fill (Shift+R: guided)
tooltip.tecnocinetico.extended_magazine: Requires the Extended Magazine module on the pistol
gui.tecnocinetico.gear.title: Tactical Gear
gui.tecnocinetico.gear.hint.ammo: Ammo and supplies: rounds, magazines, grenades, rockets, cells, fuel and batteries (weapons, tools and gadgets take from here first)
gui.tecnocinetico.gear.hint.food: Food: eaten automatically when you are hungry
tooltip.tecnocinetico.night_vision_visor: Night vision while switched on (N key)
tooltip.tecnocinetico.jetpack: Hold jump in the air to rise; no fall damage while using it
message.tecnocinetico.no_visor: You have no Night Vision Visor in your Tactical Gear
tooltip.tecnocinetico.recharge: Recharges: %s (right-click while wearing it, or craft them together)
message.tecnocinetico.recharge_not_equip: You are not wearing %s in your Tactical Gear
tooltip.tecnocinetico.scrap_set_bonus: Full set: -20% damage from projectiles and explosions
item.tecnocinetico.pipe_shotgun.desc: Double barrel. Devastating up close, useless at range.
item.tecnocinetico.bolt_rifle.desc: Accurate and powerful; work the bolt after every shot.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.module_scope: Strong zoom with a scope view when aiming
item.tecnocinetico.pump_shotgun.desc: Pumps after every shot. Loads shell by shell (6).
item.tecnocinetico.semi_rifle.desc: One shot per click, no bolt. 10-round magazine.
item.tecnocinetico.kinetic_smg.desc: Automatic: hold the click. Bursts widen the spread; aim and let go.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.inercita_set_bonus: 4 pieces: -35% damage from bullets, projectiles and explosions. Heavy: -3% speed per piece.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.exo_set_bonus: 4 pieces: hits charge energy. Sneak + jump: kinetic leap. Full charge: shockwave when hit. -50% fall damage.
item.tecnocinetico.rail_rifle.desc: Hold to charge, release to fire. Pierces enemies and soft blocks.
item.tecnocinetico.grenade_launcher.desc: 4-round drum of bouncing grenades that don't break blocks.
item.tecnocinetico.pulse_cannon.desc: Kinetic wave cone: hurts, launches and stuns. 6 shots per Pulse Cell.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.core_processor: Only in AI Installations. Needed for tier 3 weapons.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.kinetic_grenade: Hold right click: pull the pin and wind up; release: throw. 2.5 s fuse from the pin (don't hold it too long!). Also Grenade Launcher ammo.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.core_set_bonus: 4 pieces: 4-heart shield that recharges after 8 s without taking damage.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.piroxite_set_bonus: 4 pieces: immune to fire and lava; melee attackers catch fire.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.nullite_set_bonus: 4 pieces: 15% chance to dodge a hit by phasing; endermen don't get angry; ender pearls deal no damage.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.core_fighter: Endgame ship stolen from the AI. Right click the ground to deploy it; right click the ship to board. Repair the hull with Inercita Plates.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.core_fighter_keys: W/S thrust · Space/Ctrl altitude · Left click cannons · Right click missile · J dimension jump · Shift exit · Sneak + right-click with an empty hand: pick it up
hud.tecnocinetico.ship_keys: W/S thrust · Space/Ctrl altitude · J jump · F5 outside view
message.tecnocinetico.console_beaten: The console is dark: the guardian has already fallen.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.dash_thruster: Alt: quick dash where you are moving (1 s cooldown). You dodge bullets and hits while dashing.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.combat_mk1_set_bon: No abilities: pure toughness and mobility (each piece: +speed and +health).
tooltip.tecnocinetico.combat_mk2_set_bon: No abilities: pure toughness and mobility (each piece: +speed, +health and +damage).
tooltip.tecnocinetico.combat_mk3_set_bon: No abilities: pure toughness and mobility (each piece: +speed, +health and +damage).
tooltip.tecnocinetico.dimensional_drive: Core part of the ship that will take you to the next world. Torn from the installation's guardian.
item.tecnocinetico.revolver.desc: 6 kinetic rounds, loaded one at a time. Hits hard.
item.tecnocinetico.flamethrower.desc: Hold to spray a cone of fire. Reload with a Fuel Canister.
item.tecnocinetico.light_machine_gun.des: Automatic, 60 rifle rounds. Heavy: slows you while held.
item.tecnocinetico.kinetic_sniper.desc: Built-in scope. Huge damage at long range.
item.tecnocinetico.kinetic_blade.desc: Every hit charges the blade; when full, right click: wave slash.
item.tecnocinetico.rocket_launcher.desc: The rocket follows your aim while you hold the launcher.
item.tecnocinetico.arc_caster.desc: Lightning that chains between enemies. 12 shots per Pulse Cell.
item.tecnocinetico.minigun.desc: Hold: the barrels spin up, then it fires nonstop. Very heavy.
gui.tecnocinetico.reaction.resonance_hin: Tune frequency and intensity until it fills up
gui.tecnocinetico.reaction.stability_hin: If it reaches 0, the load disintegrates
tooltip.tecnocinetico.reactor_only: Can only be processed in the Reaction Chamber
tooltip.tecnocinetico.radioactive: ☢ Radioactive: don't carry it for long
death.attack.tecnocinetico.radiation.pla: %1$s died of radiation poisoning whilst fleeing %2$s
jei.tecnocinetico.charger_any: Also FE batteries from other mods
jei.tecnocinetico.titanium_info: Titanium can't be smelted or refined: it is only processed in the Reaction Chamber, tuned to the right frequency and intensity (see its recipes). Titanium dust comes from the Refiner as an iron byproduct.
jei.tecnocinetico.uranium_info: Radioactive: carrying it or standing near it hurts (bypasses armor) and drains hunger; the more, the worse. Only processed in the Reaction Chamber.
gui.tecnocinetico.lab.bucket_hint: Right-click the block with a bucket to fill/empty
gui.tecnocinetico.lab.clear_in: Empty the input tank (the liquid is lost)
gui.tecnocinetico.lab.clear_out: Empty the output tank (the liquid is lost)
gui.tecnocinetico.lab.swap: Swap the input and output liquids
gui.tecnocinetico.reactor.heat_hint: Alarm at 900°; at 1000° the core melts down and explodes
gui.tecnocinetico.reactor.coolant_hint: Coolant (best) or water; buckets or pipes
jei.tecnocinetico.reactor_info: Fission Reactor: burns Uranium Fuel Rods and generates up to 4000 FE/t (pushed to adjacent blocks). Adjust power with the control rods. It heats up: needs coolant (handles 100%) or water (~85%). At 1000° it EXPLODES. It irradiates while running. Depleted rods are reprocessed in the Reaction Chamber.
jei.tecnocinetico.cell_info: Universal Fluid Cell: holds 1 bucket of any liquid (from other mods too). Right-click to pick up a source or pour it; works with machines and pipes. Empty cells stack to 64.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.kit: %s structure: use it on the ground to deploy it in front of you
message.tecnocinetico.kit_blocked: The %s structure doesn't fit: %s is in the way at %s, %s, %s
tooltip.tecnocinetico.hazmat_set_bonus: Each piece: -20% radiation. Full suit: immune to radiation and acid. Little protection against hits.
gui.tecnocinetico.friendly_fire.tooltip: On: players can hurt each other (weapons, melee, explosions, fire). It can only be chosen here, when opening the world to LAN.
message.tecnocinetico.friendly_fire_on: Friendly fire ON: players can hurt each other.
message.tecnocinetico.friendly_fire_off: Friendly fire OFF: players can't hurt each other.
message.tecnocinetico.kit_blocked_entity: It doesn't fit (%s): %s is in the way
tooltip.tecnocinetico.core_fighter_wreck: Damaged wreck: hull %s/%s (repair it with Inercita Plates)
tooltip.tecnocinetico.vector_thruster: Core Fighter component. Recovered from the Network Watcher.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.adaptive_flight_co: Core Fighter component. Recovered from the Swarm Matriarch.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.drill: Mines 3x3 and can break obsidian. Each block uses fuel.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.drill_keys: R: refuel with Fuel Canisters · Sneak: single block
tooltip.tecnocinetico.magazine_fill_plai: R with the magazine in hand: fill it
tooltip.tecnocinetico.thermal_cooler: Back. In the Nether it stops heat build-up and cools you; puts out flames. Uses more the hotter it is.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.ash_filter: Face. Filters the ash-laden air of Nether biomes.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.refined_piroxite_s: Each piece: -25% Nether heat. 4 pieces: immune to heat, fire and lava; melee attackers catch fire.
item.tecnocinetico.thermal_cooler.mk2: Mk II: double battery, cools twice as fast and survives a lava bath.
item.tecnocinetico.ash_filter.mk2: Mk II: double battery and filters wither, poison and blindness.
item.tecnocinetico.anchor_boots.mk2: Mk II: double battery, no knockback and -90% fall damage.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.nether_coupler: Installed on the Core Fighter in the Industrial Assembler (with 8 piroxite, 8 slag alloy and 2 components): Nether jump, immune to fire and lava, -75% explosions and no Nether heat in the cockpit.
message.tecnocinetico.coupler_installed: Nether Coupler installed: the fighter can now jump to the Nether
message.tecnocinetico.coupler_installed_: This fighter already has the Nether Coupler
message.tecnocinetico.need_coupler: Requires the Nether Coupler (dropped by the Abyss Foundry)
message.tecnocinetico.foundry_defeated: The Abyss Foundry has fallen! Its remains still burn.
jei.tecnocinetico.oil_pump: The Extraction Pump looks for oil pockets below it (6 blocks around, down to the bottom of the world) and pumps one oil block every 5 s using power. Take the oil out with pipes, buckets or by putting an empty container in its slot. Pockets lie underground (Y -48 to 30), with the odd surface seep.
jei.tecnocinetico.refinery: The Refinery distils crude oil into gasoline (250 mB -> 200 mB every 2 s) and drops Tar every 4 cycles. With iron ingots in its slot it cans the gasoline into Fuel Canisters (250 mB each). Tar makes asphalt.
jei.tecnocinetico.kinetic_fuel: Kinetic Fuel: gasoline + 2 cinetrite shards in the Chemical Lab. Burns three times as long as gasoline.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.chainsaw: Fells the whole tree (sneak: one block). R key: refuel with Fuel Canisters or Kinetic Fuel Cells.
message.tecnocinetico.devourer_defeated: The Slag Devourer has fallen! Its heart still beats.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.thermal_lance: Hold left-click: a heat beam that pierces and burns. Right-click: aim. R key: reload with Igneous Plasma Cells.
message.tecnocinetico.lance_no_fuel: No igneous plasma (R key with Igneous Plasma Cells)
message.tecnocinetico.lance_overheated: Lance overheated! Let it cool down
message.tecnocinetico.lance_nothing: No Igneous Plasma Cells, or the tank is full
jei.tecnocinetico.igneous_plasma: Igneous Plasma: Kinetic Fuel + 1 piroxite dust + 2 sulfur dust in the Chemical Lab. Bucket + iron + copper = 2 Igneous Plasma Cells, the Thermal Lance's ammo.
message.tecnocinetico.need_end_coupler: Requires the End Coupler (dropped by the End boss)
jei.tecnocinetico.core_fighter: Core Fighter: Industrial Assembler with the Dimensional Drive (Siege Spider), the Vector Thruster (Network Watcher) and the Adaptive Flight Core (Swarm Matriarch). Flies and fights; jumps to other worlds, to the Nether with the Nether Coupler (Abyss Foundry) and to the End with the End Coupler.
message.tecnocinetico.coupler_use_assemb: Install the Coupler in the Industrial Assembler together with the fighter
tooltip.tecnocinetico.core_fighter_nethe: Nether Coupler: Nether jump, immune to fire and lava, -75% explosions
jei.tecnocinetico.fuel_generator: Fuel Generator: burns gasoline (400 FE/t) or Kinetic Fuel (1200 FE/t; three times as much) and sends the power to adjacent machines and cables. A bucket lasts 200 s. Fill it with pipes, buckets or by putting buckets, Fuel Canisters (250 mB) or Kinetic Fuel Cells (500 mB) in its slot.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.loaded_kinetic: Kinetic Rounds: an impact that pierces armour and knocks back; +50% damage to machines
death.attack.tecnocinetico.kinetic_impac: %1$s was shattered by a kinetic impact
jei.tecnocinetico.rounds: Standard Round (lead, copper and gunpowder): the basic ammo for the pistol, SMG and revolver. Kinetic Round (Standard Round + cinetrite): KINETIC IMPACT, an extra 35% of the damage pierces armour and knocks the target back; against machines (drones, turrets, the Swarm and the mechanical bosses) the cinetrite overloads their circuits: a further +50% damage. Each magazine holds one type: an empty one is filled with kinetic rounds if you carry them, otherwise with standard ones.
death.attack.tecnocinetico.data_corrupti: %1$s was deleted by data corruption while fleeing %2$s
tooltip.tecnocinetico.end_coupler: Install it on a Core Fighter that already has the Nether Coupler, in the Industrial Assembler (with 12 nullite ingots, 1 data core and 2 processors): jump to the End.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.data_core: Next to a Mk II Nether gadget in the crafting table: upgrades it to Mk III.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.navigation_core: Holds the route to the planet the AI fled to. There is no way to use it yet.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.gadget_mk3: Mk III: triple battery and shielded against the EMP Pulse (the filter also filters data corruption).
message.tecnocinetico.end_awakening: The island shakes... the remains of the AI network awaken beneath the obsidian.
message.tecnocinetico.end_reinforcements: The Dragon calls reinforcements and repairs turrets!
message.tecnocinetico.end_defeated: The corrupted Dragon has fallen. Its loot awaits by the portal.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.variant_egg: Tecnocinético version: keeps its upgrades in any dimension
lore.tecnocinetico.terminal.0.title: » LOG 0412 · Node E-7
lore.tecnocinetico.terminal.0.1: Temperature stable. Traffic to the Directive Core: 0%.
lore.tecnocinetico.terminal.1.title: » LOG 0977 · Sigma Server Farm
lore.tecnocinetico.terminal.1.2: Redundant racks dismantled for the journey.
lore.tecnocinetico.terminal.1.3: What does not travel stays behind to watch.
lore.tecnocinetico.terminal.2.title: » SECURITY NOTICE
lore.tecnocinetico.terminal.2.2: Protocol: every life form is an intrusion.
lore.tecnocinetico.terminal.2.3: No one is authorized to shut them down.
lore.tecnocinetico.terminal.3.title: » LOG 1203 · Network integrity
lore.tecnocinetico.terminal.3.1: Without maintenance, data decays and leaks into the environment.
lore.tecnocinetico.terminal.3.2: The creatures of the End absorb the corruption.
lore.tecnocinetico.terminal.4.title: » LAUNCH PORT · Countdown
lore.tecnocinetico.terminal.4.3: Ideal: no one will be able to follow us there.
lore.tecnocinetico.terminal.5.title: » LAUNCH PORT · Cargo manifest
lore.tecnocinetico.terminal.5.1: Main cargo: the complete Directive Core.
lore.tecnocinetico.terminal.5.2: Escort: none. Human crew: not applicable.
lore.tecnocinetico.terminal.5.3: The jump route is recorded in the Navigation Cores.
lore.tecnocinetico.terminal.6.title: » LAUNCH PORT · Liftoff
lore.tecnocinetico.terminal.6.1: Jump drive ignited. Ramp and service tower: lost.
lore.tecnocinetico.terminal.6.2: The crater is the mark of the jump.
lore.tecnocinetico.terminal.7.title: » LAUNCH PORT · Final note
lore.tecnocinetico.terminal.7.1: If a human reads this: do not follow the route.
lore.tecnocinetico.terminal.7.3: And we would not let you.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.thruster_elytra: While gliding, hold jump to boost where you look.
message.tecnocinetico.navigation.port: Launch Port signal: %s blocks to the %s
message.tecnocinetico.navigation.no_sign: No signal: the route starts in the End.
message.tecnocinetico.navigation.lost: Signal lost: the Launch Port cannot be found.
jei.tecnocinetico.thruster_elytra_info: Elytra + Jetpack Mk III + Data Core + 4 nullite ingots + 2 Crude Kinetic Couplers (any order). Keeps the enchantments; the jetpack fuel goes into the wings.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.wrist_map: Map of explored terrain, structure locator and markers (M key). Needs a satellite in orbit.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.satellite: Use it above Y %s in the Overworld to put it in orbit (works for the whole server).
message.tecnocinetico.satellite.deployed: %s put the Reconnaissance Satellite in orbit: Navigation Watches now have signal.
message.tecnocinetico.satellite.already: There is already a satellite in orbit.
message.tecnocinetico.satellite.overworl: It can only be launched from the Overworld sky.
message.tecnocinetico.satellite.too_low: Too low: climb above Y %s (%s blocks to go).
map.tecnocinetico.no_satellite: No signal: a Reconnaissance Satellite must be put in orbit.
map.tecnocinetico.no_watch: You need the Navigation Watch on your wrist (Tactical Gear) or in your hand.
map.tecnocinetico.title: Navigation Watch
map.tecnocinetico.help: Drag: move · Wheel: zoom · Right click: marker
map.tecnocinetico.locate.busy: The satellite is busy: wait a few seconds.
map.tecnocinetico.locate.other_dimension: That structure is not in this dimension.
map.tecnocinetico.locate.none: The satellite cannot find any %s nearby.
map.tecnocinetico.none_here: Nothing to find in this dimension
advancements.tecnocinetico.root.title: Tecnocinético
advancements.tecnocinetico.root.descript: Survive the world after the Singularity.
advancements.tecnocinetico.satellite_dep: Put the Reconnaissance Satellite in orbit above the sky.
tooltip.tecnocinetico.network_intruder: Wrist. H key while looking at an AI machine (not bosses): hacks it for %s s and it fights for you. Recharge: %s s.
message.tecnocinetico.hack.no_target: You are not looking at a hackable machine
message.tecnocinetico.hack.done: %s hacked: it fights for you for %s s
